jobs.title: Sales Associate - New Store Opening
jobs.why: This role builds your access, awareness, control skills and moves you toward becoming a Police Officer.
jobs.bridge: As a Sales Associate, you'll build strong communication, problem-solving, and situational awareness skills—directly transferable to de-escalation and observation in law enforcement or security. Plus, handling store procedures and customer interactions hones your ability to follow protocols and stay alert, key for any safety-focused role.

jobs.title: Theatre Security Officer - Las Vegas
jobs.why: This role builds your access, awareness, control skills and moves you toward becoming a Police Officer.
jobs.eligibility_reason: Theatre security officer; unarmed likely, no age restriction beyond 16.
jobs.bridge: As a Theatre Security Officer, you'll sharpen emergency response and reporting skills that directly transfer to police work, while your access control and customer service experience build the procedural and community engagement foundation needed for both law enforcement and advanced security roles.

jobs.title: Sales Enablement & Operations Associate
jobs.why: This role builds your access, awareness, control skills and moves you toward becoming a Police Officer.

steps: Take a free online Linux course (e.g., Linux Foundation's intro) to build comfort with command line.
Learn C++ basics via Codecademy or a free YouTube series, focusing on syntax and memory management.
Enroll in a secure coding course (e.g., OWASP's free training) to understand vulnerabilities and defenses.
Practice software development by building a small security tool (e.g., a port scanner) using C++ and Linux.
Explore AI-assisted workflows by completing a short course on AI for cybersecurity (e.g., Coursera's AI for Everyone).
